home_id.name: Home ID
home_id.description: Only for accounts with several homes: the Intuis home to act on.

user.title: Connect Your Account
user.description: Enter your Netatmo/Intuis credentials to connect your heating system.

select_home.title: Select Home
select_home.description:
Your account has multiple homes. Select which one to configure.

You can add additional homes by setting up the integration again.

indefinite.title: Override Behavior
indefinite.description: Choose what happens when temperature overrides expire.

data_description.indefinite_mode:
**ON**: Temperature changes stay active until you change them again (auto-renewed before the 12-hour hardware limit).

**OFF**: Overrides expire after their set duration and return to schedule.

overrides.title: Temperature & Duration Settings
overrides.description:
Set preset temperatures and how long overrides last.

*Note: The 12-hour maximum for Manual and Boost is a hardware limit.*

data_description.away_temp: Temperature when Away mode is active (e.g., on vacation).
data_description.manual_duration: How long manual temperature changes last.
data_description.away_duration: How long Away mode stays active.
data_description.boost_duration: How long Boost mode stays active.

energy.title: Energy Monitoring
energy.description: Configure how energy usage is tracked.

data_description.energy_scale: How often to update energy consumption data.
data_description.energy_reset_hour: Hour when daily energy counters reset (0-23). Default is 2 AM to ensure previous day's data is finalized.

history_import.title: Historical Energy Import
history_import.description:
Import historical energy consumption data from Intuis cloud.

This will populate the Energy Dashboard with past data.

data_description.import_history: Enable to import historical energy data after setup completes.
data_description.import_history_days: How far back to import energy data. Longer periods take more time due to API rate limits (~2 seconds per day).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Intuis Account
reauth_confirm.description: Session expired for {username}. Please enter your password.

energy_cost.title: Energy Cost Calculation
energy_cost.description: Automatically calculate energy consumption cost and write statistics to per-room energy_cost sensors.

data_description.energy_cost_enabled: Enables automatic cost calculation based on hourly consumption.
data_description.energy_price_mode:
**Fixed price**: use a constant rate configured here.
**HA Entity**: read the price from a sensor (Octopus, Amber, template...).
data_description.energy_fixed_price: Rate in local currency/kWh used for calculation in fixed price mode.
data_description.energy_price_entity: Sensor entity providing the price per kWh (entity mode only).

rate_limit.title: Hourly Statistics & API Rate Limiting
rate_limit.description:
Configure hourly statistics retrieval and API rate limit handling.

**Hourly Statistics**: The Intuis API has a 2-4 hour delay for energy data. This option periodically fetches past hourly data and injects it into Home Assistant statistics for accurate tracking.

data_description.hourly_stats_enabled: Enable periodic retrieval of hourly energy consumption data for accurate tracking in the Energy dashboard.
data_description.hourly_stats_interval: How often to fetch hourly statistics. 2 hours is recommended to avoid API rate limits.
data_description.rate_limit_delay: How long to wait before retrying after a rate limit error.
data_description.circuit_breaker_threshold: Number of consecutive rate limit errors before pausing all requests.
data_description.max_update_interval: Maximum polling interval when rate limited. Normally polls every 2 minutes.

data_description.energy_cost_enabled: Enables automatic cost calculation based on hourly consumption.
data_description.energy_price_mode:
**Fixed price**: use a constant rate configured here.
**HA Entity**: read the price from a sensor (Octopus, Amber, template...).
data_description.energy_fixed_price: Rate in local currency/kWh. After changing the price, run the Recalculate Cost History service to rewrite historical data.
data_description.energy_price_entity: Sensor entity providing the price per kWh (entity mode only). After changing the price, run the Recalculate Cost History service to rewrite historical data.
